newsitem.title: USA: ACX Technologies names Coors to head unit.
newsitem.headline: ACX Technologies names Coors to head unit.

text.p: ACX Technologies Inc said Friday it had chosen Joe Coors to become president and chief executive officer of Coors Ceramics Co, one of its subsidiaries.
Coors, who worked in the Office of the President of ACX, will replace Jime Wade on March 1, 1997, it said.
Wade, who plans to retire in March 1999, will gradually relieve himself of his responsibilities in order to ensure a smooth transition, it added.
ACX Technologies makes value-added industrial products like ceramics and consumer and industrial packaging.
